opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On Ryanair, search for flights from {origin} to {destination} (return or one-way) on {depart_date}/{return_date} for {passengers} adults, optionally with a {promo_code}, and select the outbound and return fares.
steps: Open the Ryanair homepage, Flights tab
Pick Return trip or One way
Click From, choose the origin country and airport
Click To, choose the destination country and airport
In the Exact dates calendar, go to the departure month and click the departure date
If it is a return trip, click the return date
Open Passengers and set the number of adults with +, then click Done
Optionally click Apply promo code and type the code
Click Search
On the results page, click Select on the outbound flight
Click Select on the return flight

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant lookup and availability Notify
opportunities.description: On Resy, set the {city}, search for a {restaurant or cuisine}, open the restaurant, set {party size} and {date}, and either pick a slot or set a Notify for a {time window} when no table is free.
steps: Open the Resy homepage
Optionally change the city in the city dropdown
Click the search box and type the restaurant name or cuisine
Pick the matching restaurant from the dropdown, or open the results list
On the restaurant page, set Guests and pick the date in the calendar
If no slot is available, click Notify
In the Set Notify dialog, choose the preferred start and end times and click Confirm

instances.values: Searched 'thai', picked Senyai Thai Kitchen (Pittsburgh), Thu Apr 6, 2 guests; Notify set for 5:00-7:00 PM
Searched 'high tide', picked High Tide (Brooklyn), changed date Apr 21 -> Mon Apr 17, 2 guests; clicked Notify for Lunch
Changed city Columbus -> Sydney, searched 'pasta'; results list showed Pasta Emilia, party of 2 today (no Notify set)

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search and ticket selection
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Attractions, search for attractions in {destination} on {date}, optionally apply filters and sorting, open {attraction}, then pick a date/time and set ticket counts per age group.
steps: Click the Attractions tab on Booking.com
Type the destination or attraction in the search box, or browse Explore more destinations by region and click a city
Open the date picker and select the date, then click Search
Optionally tick filters (category, free cancellation, city) and choose a sort tab such as Most popular
Click the attraction in the results
Choose the date and time slot in Tickets and prices
Set the number of adult, child and infant tickets and click Next
